text: {"verdict": "supported", "answer": "The Rpl38 study (source 12486491) directly reports that in Rpl38 mutant mouse embryos global protein synthesis is unchanged, while the translation of a select subset of Homeobox (Hox) mRNAs is perturbed, with RPL38 facilitating 80S complex formation on these transcripts to confer transcript-specific translational control. Thus reduction of Rpl38 alters the translational composition/selectivity of Hox mRNAs without lowering overall protein synthesis, matching the claim. Source 18987782 concerns Myc-driven protein synthesis and is not relevant to Rpl38.", "evidence_used": ["12486491"]}
